description: A minimal Scala 3 library for reading and writing JSON, cross-built for JVM, Scala.js, and Scala Native.
rules: Prefer `derives JsonRW` for case classes and enums; import `ba.sake.tupson.{*, given}` for extensions and givens.
Enable `-Yretain-trees` in consumer builds because derived parsing needs retained trees to read constructor default arguments.
For missing fields, Tupson checks constructor defaults before `JsonRW.default`; `Option`, `Seq`, and `Map` have built-in defaults.
`None` serializes as JSON `null`, and JSON `null` parses as `None`; a missing object field follows the missing-field default rules instead.
Sum types use `@type` by default with the subtype's simple name; use `@discriminator("key")` to select a different field.
Union alternatives are tried left to right when parsing, while writing selects by runtime type; order alternatives carefully when parsing is ambiguous.
Generic products and ADTs can derive `JsonRW`, but true GADT case refinements require manually written codecs.
Catch `ParsingException` to inspect all path-aware `ParseError`s accumulated during derived parsing.
`tupson-config` is a separate JVM-only integration; use the separate `tupson-sttp` artifact for sttp client4.
